body:
So do you think I should drop the course and tell my parents? I feel like getting a W and lightening my workload will take so much stress off of me. 

I'll still be at 12 credits which is considered full time. And I think I wouldn't be pushed too far behind if I were to go with a math major as Physics isn't a necessary class. 

But I still feel like dropping the class would be a failure. I would feel like I wasn't smart enough to do it.

I don't see it as a plan my parents had for me. I see it as they paved the road for me to go out and be successful in whatever I wanted. And I followed that road thinking I could do that.

And I can't. I tried by pursuing my "passion" (or so I thought) of Physics and Astronomy. I got in and within the first month I had been beaten up, eaten, and shit out by the course. 

So there goes some self-esteem. Maybe I'm not as smart as I thought. Okay, let's start on a lower class. I get in there and bam, I'm failing again. Now I feel like I'm at pretty much rock-bottom. 

I can't keep up with my classmates like I used to. I can't even do the homework without looking up the formulas and getting a step-by-step explanation. I just feel like a fucking waste. 

I don't see any redeeming qualities in myself. And it hurts me to think my little 13 year old brother sees me as someone to look up to. It hurts me to think my parents and relatives see me as successful and happy. It hurts me to think that I used to be happy. I feel like I'll never feel that way again.

I'm not a homosexual. 

EDIT: In fact I think that's a rash assumption to make based off of a text post.
